code: blosc2_schunk* schunk = blosc2_schunk_from_buffer((uint8_t *) data, size, false);
note: Fuzz target entry: raw input bytes are parsed as a b2frame via blosc2_schunk_from_buffer with copy=false, creating an in-memory frame-backed schunk.
The raw buffer is wrapped as a frame with avoid_cframe_free=true (copy=false), so the frame's cframe points directly into the fuzz input buffer.
A schunk is allocated with calloc, so schunk->data is NULL and schunk->frame points to the frame wrapping the input buffer.
A destination buffer of schunk->nbytes+1 bytes is allocated for decompressed chunk data.

code: dsize = blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk(schunk, nchunk, uncompressed_data + i, schunk->chunksize);
note: Each chunk is decompressed through blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk, which dispatches to frame_decompress_chunk for frame-backed schunks.

code: chunksize = frame_decompress_chunk(schunk->dctx, frame, nchunk, dest, nbytes);
note: Since schunk->frame is non-NULL, decompression is delegated to frame_decompress_chunk.
frame_get_lazychunk retrieves the compressed chunk data and sets needs_free accordingly.
The chunk offset is read from the frame's coffsets chunk. A crafted offset can point to a location within the frame that is not a valid heap allocation.
For in-memory frames, the chunk pointer is set to a location inside the input buffer (frame->cframe). needs_free remains false, so no free is performed on this pointer.

code: int32_t chunksize = blosc2_decompress_ctx(dctx, src, chunk_cbytes, dest, nbytes);
note: The chunk is decompressed. If the chunk header declares a special value (runlen), handle_runlen may take a path that interacts with the destination buffer.

If needs_free is true, src is freed. For in-memory frames needs_free is false, so this free is skipped. The invalid-free occurs when a crafted frame causes a path where a non-heap pointer is freed or the same pointer is freed twice.
invariant: free must only be called on pointers returned by a matching allocation function

note: The schunk is freed at the end. If schunk->data contains pointers into the frame's cframe buffer (not heap-allocated), blosc2_schunk_free will call free() on them, causing an Invalid-free.
